_about: The ship tab of the airship screen. sheet: the drawing under the layers (pack path; web/art/blueprint_base.png is the base barge of tools/web_art.py). parts: the details that buildings bring, each its own layer on the drawing and its own model in 3D. building: the level without the prefix that brings it, null while the mod has no such building yet; enabled: connected on the page now (false: only the data is ready, the step to come is to set it true). Drawing layers: pencil, build, ink in web/art/layers.json or data/crew_ui_art.json (null: not drawn yet); turns_at: where the turns left are written while it is built, in units of the drawing (1040 x 760). model.part: build/web/models/<part>.gltf (tools/web_export.py); model.hides: nodes of the base hull it replaces; source: where the model comes from. stages: what the page shows at each stage of the ship, ?stage=<name> in the address; stage: the one shown without it. planks: the bare timber of the yard (tools/web_art.py, planks b), no buildings yet, no model; barge: the base barge with the guns' first building and the details. hull1: the hull's first level alone (carrier: the part every other detail and every crew place stands on, none of them shown while it is not built; base: a part of the hull itself, shown without it; sheets: the drawing per stage of sheet_part: bare timber, the same with the frame hatched over it, the frame; built: what stands at the start of this stage, overriding web/data/sim.json; demolish: the demolish button shown; frame_scheme: a scheme of keel and frames from three.js primitives in 3D while the frame stands, there is no model of it). tree: the stage's buildings as a tree (nodes: levels without the prefix; links from the data; direction: down, the first buildings on top, or up). tree_demo: the example shown by ?tree=demo; ?dir=up|down overrides the direction. sheets: a list of rules, the first whose part is at its stage gives the drawing, the last is the default. model_when: the part whose building shows the base barge in 3D (hull_base, no details); before it the frame's scheme or the text. demolish_mode step_down: demolishing a level leaves the level below standing (the game removes the whole building), and only the top level of a chain may be demolished. malakai_side: the chooser of Malakai's side (plan and marks of web/art/layers.json, malakai_side); show_when: the part whose building must stand. tree.requires: what a node needs on the page beyond the mod's data (the mod's requirement of these buildings is the hull's tier only); tree.not_connected: nodes shown, not yet orderable. tree.branches: side branches off the trunk (the hull): their nodes, the colour of their frame and lines (a name of data/crew_options.json, card_frames: tools/web_art.py draws branch_frame_<colour>.png and tree_line_<colour>.png), the side they stand on, shift: how many columns of the game (106) right of that side's column the branch stands, a side branch whose line leaves its parent by the side. crew_cards: the crew a building opens, as small unit cards beside that building's node in the tree, the way the game's building browser shows the units a building unlocks (ui/templates/building_frame.twui.xml, units_list), at the game's size and place, the game's frame in the crew group's colour: group and option of data/crew_options.json (the picture comes from build/web/data.json, unit_card), building: the node, crew_areas: the places of the crew groups on the drawing that the player clicks to choose their crew (web/js/panel.js, makeCrewArea; layers web/art/crew_<group>_empty, _<option>, _<option>_sketch, _tag_<sign>, _hover of tools/web_art.py; web/art/layers.json, crew_areas: the box and the tag's glow): group, head: the title of the choice, kind_name and stats_head: the lines of the unit's panel, words: how the place speaks of its crew (at, stand, come, came, leave, left, nobody, empty_name, who), cards: drawn for the mod's own drawn cards in place of the game's unit cards, closeup for the close views of tools/web_art.py (build/web/game/ui/tww3_mtb_cards), per: whom the ammunition's volleys are counted for (на стрелка), hides_part: a detail the crew takes the place of. A place appears with the building that opens the group's mount (data/crew_options.json, mount: the ports, hatches, rings), a group without a mount with the first building that opens a kind of it; which building that is comes from the tree (crew of its nodes), not from here. movie: web/art/<movie>.webm or .mp4 of the demo window on hover (a placeholder until the file is there), head and text of that window.

hull1.caption: Дерево построек корабля: заготовка, прочный корпус, пивной чертог, манекены для стрелков.

crew_cards.head: Мстители-пираты
crew_cards.text: Одиннадцать Мстителей у бортов: в одной руке пистоль, в другой тесак. Бьют часто и в упор.

crew_cards.head: Арбалетчики
crew_cards.text: Одиннадцать арбалетчиков у бортов. Болт летит далеко и ложится туда, куда смотрел гном.

crew_cards.head: Пушка барки
crew_cards.text: Два ствола в носовых портах. Ядро идёт низко над землёй и проламывает строй насквозь.

crew_cards.head: Огненные снаряды
crew_cards.text: Та же пушка, но снаряд рвётся горючей смесью: горит цель, горят соседи.

crew_cards.head: Органное орудие
crew_cards.text: Стволы на одном лафете бьют подряд, и враг слышит один долгий раскат.

crew_cards.head: Пулемёт
crew_cards.text: Связка стволов крутится и сыплет пулями, каждая лопается маленьким огнём.

crew_cards.head: Огненная пушка
crew_cards.text: Из пасти золотого дракона бьёт пламя, далеко и очередью. Где прошла струя, остаётся пепел.

crew_cards.head: Бомбы
crew_cards.text: Тяжёлые бомбы ждут над люками. Створки расходятся, и земля под баркой встаёт дыбом.

crew_cards.head: Огненные бомбы
crew_cards.text: Бомба лопается в воздухе, и на врага падает дождь горящих осколков.

crew_cards.head: Гранаты
crew_cards.text: Мстители с макушки шара швыряют гранаты сверху: за щитом от них не укрыться.

crew_cards.head: Топоры
crew_cards.text: Рейнджеры в гнёздах мечут по три топора за раз. Топоров мало, промахов ещё меньше.

crew_cards.head: Гарпун
crew_cards.text: Тяжёлое копьё с крючьями бьёт из пасти льва на носу шара. Один выстрел за бой, и крупного зверя он пробивает насквозь.
